text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(I'll engrave it into your brain! My 
race—!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Kh...! Dammit! If only I could've become a 
Triple Crown Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator
text_block_list.text:
N-No, but that was an incredible run! Even 
without the Classic Triple Crown... She 
could go on to win five, six GⅠs from 
here...!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right! If it's C.B., she'll 
definitely pull it off in the Senior Year!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
She can do it! She can even surpass the 
'Myth'! I know she will, right?!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it was a race that made me feel 
that kind of potential.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Still, the glory of the Classic Triple 
Crown is immense. If she couldn't claim 
it... then at this point, the "Myth" 
remains stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ――…… Ace, this one's for you……

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This heat, this speed... I give everything 
in this race to you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
My bad, C.B. You really are amazing after 
all. What an incredible race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ace...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"And then, my eyes were finally opened. 
...Sorry for everything up till now."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're not a wall, you're an opponent. A 
formidable rival who tries to snatch my 
victory away.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just "wanting to surpass" won't win it. I 
have to knock you down flat.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The spark has finally caught fire!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Next time I'll beat you! No, whether 
you're there or not, I'm gonna win every 
single race!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
My race... That's where the rebellious 
"Ace" begins!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace's eyes locked straight onto 
Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No. I'm just so happy. I'm glad, thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...I'm looking forward to the next race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, Katsuragi Ace fearlessly grasps the 
right hand Mr. C.B. has offered."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Public opinion didn't matter. For Mr. 
C.B., the Kikuka Sho had granted her a 
treasure far greater than words could ever 
convey.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, you. Have you noticed anything 
about C.B.'s legs?”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
She's playing it off well, but she's 
definitely feeling something off right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, taking a reluctant Mr. C.B. to 
the hospital—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It's mild, but you have sprained it. 
Please rest for a few days.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, and here I was doing so well 
playing dumb, until Ace had to go and...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Rehab periods are so boring. They're 
making a fuss over nothing anyway.
choice_data_list:
I'm not exaggerating. Let's make sure it's 
properly treated.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Okaaay. Guess I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with visible reluctance, her 
recuperation period began—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"The next race, huh? Which one should we 
go for?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"A GⅠ race would be great. It was fun. A 
heated one where Ace would probably show 
up, too..."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about this one? The "Takarazuka 
Kinen"! Popular girls are strong girls, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...I'm hoping for some excitement as hot 
as the Classic season!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The recovery period ended without issue, 
and the days of training towards her next 
race, the Takarazuka Kinen, had begun!
